info.name: lassy-retrieval-service
info.description: Standalone HTTP ingestion, retrieval, optional local reranking, feedback and metrics. Configure the service through .env; clients generate answers. Set base_url, run Ingest Content, then Query. Query saves query_id for Submit Feedback only when tracking succeeds. Ingest URL is an optional external-source example; change ingest_url as needed. The API still requires the feedback table; initialize the current schema before using this collection.

request.description: Root endpoint — returns service name, version, and status.
Checks database access, required schema and configured embedding dimensions. Returns 200 when ready or 503 when unavailable/incompatible.
Optional: ingest the URL in ingest_url. Requires network access from the service. Change the variable to your documentation URL.
Start here for a local smoke check. This sample exceeds the default 50-word minimum chunk size and needs no source URL. The service still needs its local embedding model and initialized database.

Returns ranked chunks, citation labels, retrieval/reranking scores, query_id, feedback_available and metrics. Generation belongs to the client. top_k overrides the environment default; optional filters match metadata. Retrieval is the default; legacy retrieve_only:true remains accepted, while false returns 422. The response script saves query_id only when feedback_available is true.
Submit a 0-10 rating for retrieved context. Run Query first to populate query_id. Feedback requires successful query tracking and the feedback table; 7+ counts as satisfied.

exec: throw new Error("Run Query successfully first; feedback requires feedback_available=true.");

request.description: Aggregate query counts, average/median/p95 retrieval latency, average reranking latency, feedback counts and satisfaction. Empty aggregates may be null. No profile selection or generation cost metrics.
